# Sri Murugan Thirumana Mandapam

> The favourite wedding venue of over 1,000 families, next to Velachery bus stand.

Website: https://srimuruganmandapam.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98411 09365

## Contact
- Sri Murugan Thirumana Mandapam · #15 Gangai Nagar, 100 Ft Bypass Road, Velachery, Chennai 600 042 · 044 2259 3501 · +91 98411 09365 · srimurugankalyanamandapam@gmail.com

## Key facts
- 500 guests in the A/C hall
- 150 in the A/C dining hall
- 7 air-conditioned rooms
- serving families since 2002

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C hall & dining
- 250 KV standby generator
- Vessels, tables & chairs included
- Hygienic bedding, no extra cost
- 24/7 hot water
- Housekeeping during functions
- CCTV across the mandapam
- Fire extinguishers on every floor
- Valet parking on request

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Sri Murugan Thirumana Mandapam hold?
500 guests in the centralised A/C hall and 150 in the A/C dining hall.

### Where is Sri Murugan Thirumana Mandapam?
#15 Gangai Nagar, 100 Ft Bypass Road, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Sri Murugan Thirumana Mandapam have?
Centralised A/C hall & dining, 250 KV standby generator, Vessels, tables & chairs included, Hygienic bedding, no extra cost, 24/7 hot water, Housekeeping during functions, CCTV across the mandapam, Fire extinguishers on every floor, Valet parking on request.

### What is included in the rent?
Vessels, tables, chairs and spacious air-conditioned rooms are included in the rent.

### How do I get there?
It is on the 100 Ft Bypass Road next to Velachery bus stand, 3 km from Velachery railway station.

### How do I check if Sri Murugan Thirumana Mandapam is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98411 09365.
